defs.def: lasting only a short time; short 短时间的；短暂的

ex.s: Since passengers are just passing through, our interactions are brief.
ex.t: 由于乘客只是路过，因此我们的互动时间很短。

ex.s: 55  , after a brief stay in hospital, Ben was well enough to be allowed to   56   and later the family met up for dinner.
ex.t: 55  ，在医院短暂停留后，本康复到可以___56___，后来全家聚在一起吃晚饭。

ex.s: His book A Brief History of Time is an international bestseller.
ex.t: 他的《时间简史》是一本国际畅销书。

ex.s: This brief visit with Mother Nature cost me two days off from work, recovering from a bad case of sunburn and the doctor’s bill for my son’s food poisoning.
ex.t: 这次与大自然的短暂接触让我请了两天假，还因为严重的晒伤和儿子食物中毒的医药费而恢复了好一阵子。

defs.def: using few words 简洁的；简单的

ex.s: Being clear and brief — while maintaining interest and including everything your listeners need to know — is a high-level communication skill.
ex.t: 做到清晰简洁——同时维持吸引力并包含听众需要知道的一切——是一项高阶的沟通技巧。

defs.def: short and not covering much of the body 衣服
the instructions that a person is given explaining what their job is and what their duties are 任务简介；指示

ex.s: We shared the brief that if you’re fortunate enough to have success, you should put something back — he with his Newman’s Own food and his Hole in the Wall camps for kids who are seriously ill, and me with Sundance and the institute and the festival.
ex.t: 我们有着共同的信念：如果你有幸获得成功，就应该回馈社会——他通过纽曼自有食品和为重病儿童举办的"墙上的洞"夏令营，而我则通过圣丹斯电影节及其研究所和艺术节。

ex.s: We shared the brief that if you’re fortunate enough to have success, you should put something back - he with his Newman’s Own food and his Hole in the Wall camps for kids who are seriously ill, and me with Sundance and the institute and the festival.
ex.t: 我们有着共同的信念：如果你有幸获得成功，就应该回馈社会——他通过他的Newman's Own食品品牌和为重病儿童创办的Hole in the Wall夏令营来回报，而我则通过圣丹斯及其协会和电影节来回报。

defs.def: a legal case that is given to a lawyer to argue in court; a piece of work for a barrister （向辩护律师提供的）案情摘要；委托辩护

ex.s: Artwork Statement: Please provide a brief statement (maximum 150 words) outlining your artwork concept.
ex.t: 作品阐述：请提供一段简要说明（最多150词），概述你的作品构思。

defs.def: a written summary of the facts that support one side of a legal case, that will be presented to a court 辩护状

ex.s: Closing Paragraph: Give a brief summary of the experience.
ex.t: 结尾段：简要总结这次经历。

defs.def: a solicitor or a defence lawyer 事务律师；辩护律师
官员正敦促在下一次总统的简报中一定要包括这个目标。

ex.s: It’s a brief account of a trip.
ex.t: 它是一趟旅程的简要记述。

ex.s: Begin your essay with a brief summary of the story.
ex.t: 以对故事的简要概括开头来写你的文章。

defs.def: to give sb information about sth so that they are prepared to deal with it 给（某人）指示；向（某人）介绍情况

ex.s: To give a brief account of AI history.
Use the notes above to help you give a brief introduction to the Lantern Festival.
ex.t: 用上面的笔记帮你对元宵节作一个简要介绍。

defs.def: to give a lawyer, especially a barrister, the main facts of a legal case so that it can be argued in court 向（辩护律师）提供案情摘要

ex.s: Find more sentences containing relative clauses from the text on page 4, and discuss briefly with a partner the major functions of them.
ex.t: 从第4页的课文中找出更多含定语从句的句子，并与同伴简要讨论它们的主要功用。
